claims.claim: The package architecture is Components to hooks to stores to APIs/realtime, with one canonical entity record and ID-only lists.
Prometheus Entity Management 3.0.2 uses React state for CRUD edit buffers and mutation lifecycle state.
useEntities performs one batch entity upsert, then one setEntityFetched publication per row, then one list-result publication.
useEntityAugment patches are shared overlays and are not the isolated CRUD edit buffer.
createGraphTransaction provides rollback but does not batch publications because its methods call store actions immediately.
The N+2 list publication defect remains present in both the v3.0.2 tag and latest origin/main.
External-store subscriptions rerender a subscriber when its selected snapshot changes; neither React nor Zustand promises zero rerenders.
Local draft state can be valid when isolated from committed data, but business state need not reside in the component when an explicit graph draft entity is required.
Narrow stable selectors can avoid unrelated rerenders but cannot eliminate a rerender when selected data changes.
Opening Session Configuration downloads 2,611,291 bytes and hydrates 7,248 catalog models with one imperative graph action per model; Chrome becomes unresponsive while the service remains healthy.
UAR does not register entity transports and instead uses REST-wrapper Zustand stores plus raw graph selectors.
UAR already defines AgentSessionEntity but the Session Configuration flow does not use it as canonical state.
The panel POSTs model_override and context_strategy while the backend AgentSessionConfig accepts model and no context_strategy field.
The current frontend never loads saved session configuration and the turn request builder uses the selected agent's model, leaving the session model control a dead facade.
The configured-provider endpoint returns 3,949 bytes, five providers, and twelve configured models, which is the bounded inventory the selector requires.
